mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 4.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions with unemployment below 4.0%, overheating risks trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and economy is in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 150,000 jobs per month signal robust labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic expansion with quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.5% supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 QoQ > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) combined with a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals active monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% AND FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.
